page.notes: The bottom-right mark reads as a gathering signature with a page figure; uncertain. The word "successf." and "postumo" are doubtful readings, as are several abbreviations in the right column (e.g. "liberta.causa"). Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably in "viduitatis", "fuccess.liberr." and "Libertas inaestimabilis". The entry "Liberorum ap. ... §.1.220." appears as printed.
